read and follow instructions on enclosed leaflet.

1) shampoo hair using a manic panic prepare to dye clarifying shampoo. apply to freshly washed & dried hair 2) empty desired amount into coloring bowl and apply evenly with a tint brush 3) do not apply to scalp, but 1/2 inch from the scalp. saturate hair thoroughly. comb evenly through the hair until it becomes frothy. 4) cover hair in a plastic cap. leave on 30 minutes or longer. for more intensity add heat 5) rinse hair in cold water away from face and body until it runs almost clear.
